children: Jaguar Health entered into privately negotiated exchange agreements with Streeterville Capital to reduce debt tied to its 2025 Note. In the transaction, the company issued 547,898 common shares in exchange for a $5,049,909.26 reduction of the secured promissory note originally issued on Nov 12, 2025 for $10.81 million. As of Sep 23, 2026, Jaguar Health reported approximately 1,281,867 shares outstanding. The exchange is intended to lower leverage and improve financial flexibility.
